# Footnotes

A reference whose definition follows it[^after], in a sentence long enough to
show where the note lands on the page.

[^before]: A definition written above the reference that cites it.

A second paragraph cites the note defined above it[^before], and cites the
first note again[^AFTER], spelled in another case.

[^after]: A note with *emphasis*, `inline code`, and more below.

    A second paragraph inside the same definition.

    - a list item
    - a second list item
